**[3]** Step 1: the model. Keys are declared so Zetaris generates PK/FK checks. Composite natural keys (day + campaign, day + device, ...) are folded into one string key, because RUN DQ checks one key column at a time.

```sql
COMPILE USL growth DEPLOY NAMESPACE lightning.metastore.whybot_usl DDL
CREATE TABLE campaign (
    campaign_id int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_name varchar(100),
    channel varchar(30),
    platform varchar(30),
    objective varchar(30)
);
CREATE TABLE ad_daily (
    ad_day_key varchar(30) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    spend_date date,
    campaign_id int FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES campaign(campaign_id),
    spend_usd decimal(10,2),
    impressions int,
    clicks int
);
CREATE TABLE holiday (
    holiday_date date NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    holiday_names varchar(200),
    is_federal int
);
CREATE TABLE funnel_daily (
    funnel_key varchar(30) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    event_date date,
    device varchar(10),
    form_views int,
    form_submits int,
    tracked_signups int,
    accounts_created int
);
CREATE TABLE signups_by_channel (
    channel_day_key varchar(50) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    signup_date date,
    channel varchar(30),
    device varchar(10),
    tracked_signups int,
    accounts_created int
)
```

**[5]** ad_daily: one row per campaign per day.

```sql
ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.ad_daily AS

       spend_date, CAST(campaign_id AS INT) AS campaign_id, CAST(spend_usd AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS spend_usd,
       CAST(impressions AS INT) AS impressions, CAST(clicks AS INT) AS clicks
FROM ads_pg.ad_spend_daily
```

**[6]** holiday: the live canada-holidays.ca API can return two holidays on one day (30 Sep: Truth and Reconciliation + Orange Shirt Day), so fold them into one row per date to keep holiday_date a real key.

```sql
ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.holiday AS
SELECT COALESCE(holiday_date, DATE '1970-01-01') AS holiday_date,
       CAST(concat_ws(' / ', sort_array(collect_list(holiday_name))) AS STRING) AS holiday_names,
       CAST(max(is_federal) AS INT) AS is_federal
FROM whybot.ca_holidays
GROUP BY holiday_date
```

**[7]** funnel_daily: analytics events pivoted in one pass, joined to backend accounts (a different table, so no repeated read).

```sql
ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.funnel_daily AS
SELECT COALESCE(concat(CAST(e.event_date AS STRING), '-', e.device), '') AS funnel_key,
       e.event_date, e.device,
       CAST(e.form_views AS INT) AS form_views, CAST(e.form_submits AS INT) AS form_submits,
       CAST(e.tracked_signups AS INT) AS tracked_signups, CAST(COALESCE(a.accounts, 0) AS INT) AS accounts_created
FROM (SELECT event_date, device,
             sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'signup_form_view' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS form_views,
             sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'signup_form_submit' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS form_submits,
             sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'trial_signup' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS tracked_signups
      FROM app_pg.tracking_events_daily GROUP BY event_date, device) e
LEFT JOIN (SELECT to_date(created_at) AS d, device, count(*) AS accounts
           FROM app_pg.accounts GROUP BY to_date(created_at), device) a
  ON e.event_date = a.d AND e.device = a.device
```

**[8]** signups_by_channel: the dashboard metric next to the backend truth, per channel and device.

```sql
ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.signups_by_channel AS
SELECT COALESCE(concat(CAST(t.signup_date AS STRING), '-', t.channel, '-', t.device), '') AS channel_day_key,
       t.signup_date, t.channel, t.device,
       CAST(t.signups AS INT) AS tracked_signups, CAST(COALESCE(a.accounts, 0) AS INT) AS accounts_created
FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT to_date(created_at) AS d, signup_channel, device, count(*) AS accounts
           FROM app_pg.accounts GROUP BY to_date(created_at), signup_channel, device) a
  ON t.signup_date = a.d AND t.channel = a.signup_channel AND t.device = a.device
```

**[9]** Step 3: data quality. tracked_not_above_submits: the trial_signup event fires after a form submit, so a day where tracked signups exceed submits means double-firing events.

```sql
REGISTER DQ tracked_not_above_submits TABLE lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.funnel_daily AS
tracked_signups <= form_submits
```

**[10]** tracking_coverage_90: the analytics event should capture at least 90% of the accounts the backend actually created. Days that fail are measurement problems, not demand problems.

```sql
REGISTER DQ tracking_coverage_90 TABLE lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.funnel_daily AS
tracked_signups >= 0.9 * accounts_created
```

### data/zetaris/usl_queries.sql

**[1]** U1. Is the 18% drop real? Dashboard (tracked) vs backend (created) per device, prior vs last week, in one pass over funnel_daily.

```sql
SELECT device,
       sum(CASE WHEN event_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN tracked_signups END) AS tracked_prior,
       sum(CASE WHEN event_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN tracked_signups END) AS tracked_last,
       sum(CASE WHEN event_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN accounts_created END) AS created_prior,
       sum(CASE WHEN event_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN accounts_created END) AS created_last,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN event_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN tracked_signups END) / sum(CASE WHEN event_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN accounts_created END), 3) AS coverage_last
FROM lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.funnel_daily
WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY device
ORDER BY device
```

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| desktop | 1309 | 1171 | 1334 | 1200 | 0.976 |
| mobile | 851 | 600 | 871 | 800 | 0.75 |

**[2]** U2. Cross-source, day by day: paid-search spend (ads_pg) next to paid-search accounts created (app_pg) and the holiday calendar (REST API).

```sql
SELECT s.spend_date, date_format(s.spend_date, 'E') AS dow, s.paid_search_spend, a.paid_search_accounts, h.holiday_names
FROM (SELECT d.spend_date, round(sum(d.spend_usd), 2) AS paid_search_spend
      FROM lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.ad_daily d
      JOIN lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.campaign c ON d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
      WHERE c.channel = 'paid_search' AND d.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
      GROUP BY d.spend_date) s
JOIN (SELECT signup_date, sum(accounts_created) AS paid_search_accounts
      FROM lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.signups_by_channel
      WHERE channel = 'paid_search' AND signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
      GROUP BY signup_date) a ON s.spend_date = a.signup_date
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.holiday h ON s.spend_date = h.holiday_date
ORDER BY s.spend_date
```

**[3]** U3. Which channels really lost accounts? Backend accounts per channel, prior vs last week, with the tracked figure beside it.

```sql
SELECT channel,
       sum(CASE WHEN signup_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN accounts_created END) AS created_prior,
       sum(CASE WHEN signup_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN accounts_created END) AS created_last,
       sum(CASE WHEN signup_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN accounts_created END) - sum(CASE WHEN signup_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN accounts_created END) AS created_change,
       sum(CASE WHEN signup_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN tracked_signups END) - sum(CASE WHEN signup_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN tracked_signups END) AS tracked_change
FROM lightning.metastore.whybot_usl.growth.signups_by_channel
WHERE signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY created_change
```
